title: RoleRevokeRequest
description: The input of role.revoke: the person, the role it ends, active or pending, and the reason. This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that changes people or roles (step 43b's README).

person.description: The person's address in the company, such as dsor://org_456/person/cfo_100. Loose on purpose: an address that names no active person of the company is refused by the command's own check, after line ② has checked the company, as login.invite does since step 43.

role.description: A role that roles.json has, such as CFO or ap_clerk. What a role may do is DSoR's to say (step 43b's README, decision L6).

reason.description: Why, in the administrator's own words, for the people who read the log.
